meta.event: RTC+B (real-time co-optimization plus batteries) went live in ERCOT on Dec 5, 2025
meta.matching: each after-day is paired with the same calendar day one year earlier; a pair is used only if both days have results
meta.revenue_units: $ per kW over the matched days (not annualized)
meta.rt_minus_da: each 15-min RT price minus the DA price of the hour that contains it
meta.rt_intraday_std: standard deviation of the 15-min RT price within each day, averaged (or median) over days
meta.caveat: Before/after describes what changed, not why. Battery capacity kept growing, and load, gas prices, weather and transmission also changed between the windows. This model cannot isolate the effect of RTC+B from those, and it leaves out ancillary services, where RTC+B changes battery revenue most directly.
